How GymPulse uses Health Connect
When you finish a workout, GymPulse writes it to Health Connect as an exercise session with start and end time, title and notes.

GymPulse reads your body weight from Health Connect only to show it in the settings. It is saved as a body measurement only when you tap Import. If you allow it, GymPulse also reads heart rate, steps and active calories for the time of a finished workout and, with the separate sleep switch, your last sleep before the workout. These values are only shown in the workout summary and are not saved. They can come from any app that writes to Health Connect.
Your data stays on your device. GymPulse does not send health data to servers, does not use it for advertising and does not share it with others.
You can turn the connection off in the GymPulse settings at any time and revoke the permissions in Health Connect.
